newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Petzetakis says 96 sales up 26pct.
newsitem.headline: Greek Petzetakis says 96 sales up 26pct.

text.p: Greek plastic pipes manufacturer Petzetakis said in a statement that its 1996 sales rose 26.1 percent to 16.7 billion drachmas from 13.2 billion in 1995.
Sales would have been higher had it not been for the relocation of the factory to Thebes from Moschato that reduced productivity and forced the non-implementation of important contracts, it said.

The firm's German subsidiary, Petzetakis GmbH, moved its warehouse to new, bigger automated warehouses in central Germany to facilitate the servicing of clients in the important export markets of central Europe, it said.
Sales of Macedonian Plastics, a subsidiary of Petzetakis, increased to 7.0 billion drachmas in 1996 from 5.8 billion in 1995, an increase of 20 percent, it said.
But no profit figures for Petzetakis or Macedonian Plastics were mentioned in the statement.
